SELECT reference_article,
       type_promotion,
       to_char(date_debut, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date_debut,
       to_char(date_fin,   'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date_fin
FROM promotions_dji;

WITH v AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF($1::text,  '')::int       AS id_declaration,
        NULLIF($2::text,  '')::int       AS ligne_num,
        NULLIF($3::text,  '')::int       AS id_customer,
        NULLIF($4::text,  '')            AS declaration_reference,
        NULLIF($5::text,  '')            AS nom_du_client,
        NULLIF($6::text,  '')            AS type_de_promo,
        NULLIF($7::text,  '')            AS ref_article,
        NULLIF($8::text,  '')            AS designation,
        NULLIF($9::text,  '')::date      AS date_debut,
        NULLIF($10::text, '')::date      AS date_fin,
        NULLIF($11::text, '')::int       AS quantite,
        NULLIF($12::text, '')::numeric   AS compensation_ht,
        NULLIF($13::text, '')::numeric   AS total,
        NULLIF($14::text, '')            AS ref_avoir,
        NULLIF($15::text, '')::timestamp AS date_declaration
),
orig AS (
    SELECT e.id_declaration, e.declaration_reference, e.date_declaration
    FROM public.declarations_export e
    JOIN v ON e.id_customer    =  v.id_customer
          AND e.ref_article    =  v.ref_article
          AND e.date_fin       IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.date_fin
          AND e.id_declaration IS DISTINCT FROM v.id_declaration
    ORDER BY e.date_declaration NULLS LAST, e.id_declaration
    LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO public.declarations_export (
    id_declaration, ligne_num, id_customer, declaration_reference,
    nom_du_client, type_de_promo, ref_article, designation,
    date_debut, date_fin, quantite, compensation_ht, total, ref_avoir,
    date_declaration, is_retard, is_doublon,
    doublon_de_declaration, doublon_de_reference, doublon_de_date
)
SELECT
    v.id_declaration, v.ligne_num, v.id_customer, v.declaration_reference,
    v.nom_du_client, v.type_de_promo, v.ref_article, v.designation,
    v.date_debut, v.date_fin, v.quantite, v.compensation_ht, v.total, v.ref_avoir,
    v.date_declaration,
    COALESCE(v.date_fin IS NOT NULL
             AND v.date_declaration IS NOT NULL
             AND v.date_declaration::date > v.date_fin + 7, FALSE),
    (o.id_declaration IS NOT NULL),
    o.id_declaration, o.declaration_reference, o.date_declaration
FROM v LEFT JOIN orig o ON TRUE
ON CONFLICT (id_declaration, ligne_num) DO NOTHING
RETURNING
    declaration_reference,
    nom_du_client,
    type_de_promo,
    ref_article,
    designation,
    to_char(date_debut,       'YYYY-MM-DD')         AS date_debut_txt,
    to_char(date_fin,         'YYYY-MM-DD')         AS date_fin_txt,
    quantite,
    compensation_ht,
    total,
    ref_avoir,
    is_retard,
    is_doublon,
    doublon_de_reference,
    to_char(doublon_de_date,  'DD/MM/YYYY')         AS doublon_de_date_txt,
    to_char(date_declaration, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS date_declaration_txt;
